description: This file defines a function `buildAppTheme` that constructs and returns a customized theme data (ThemeData) object for a Flutter application. The theme customizes various UI components such as AppBar, Card, InputDecoration, FloatingActionButton, Chip, ProgressIndicator, and BottomNavigationBar using specific color schemes and style configurations.

methods.name: buildAppTheme
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData object customized with specific color schemes and style settings for use in a Flutter app.
